Classic+ has 78 cards (`classicplus-001` to `classicplus-078`) and 38 tokens: - 55 of the cards are Spells, Field Spells, Traps or Field Traps; 10 of those are Field Spells. - 18 are Units with a Cry, Death, trigger or Activate in their text. Crushing Walls (classicplus-024) already has a bespoke animation. Keep it. Read `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md`, and the "A task over every card" section of `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, first. This is a pass over every card. ### The measure - **Spells and Traps:** every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap gets a motif, or a bespoke key, on its `cast` hook. - **Units with a hook:** every Unit whose Cry, Death, trigger or Activate changes the board gets a motif on that hook. - **Field Spells:** each also gets an `aura` entry. - **Vanilla Units:** may be `"none: vanilla"`. - **Tokens:** this set has 38, so give one an entry only where it earns one, and list which ones you gave entries in the PR. - **Choosing a motif:** - Pick it from `cargo jackioh fx census` (#2788), never by comparing card texts, and give a reason wherever you override it. - Use sub-looks (#2792) where several cards share a flavor. - Take the scale from the card's cost and rarity. - **Bespoke:** 3 to 6 Flourishes, built from motif primitives, each with a one-line reason. - **Legendary and Mythic entrances:** #2722's entrance and takeover animations are open to change (#2782); the owner finds them weak. A Legendary's or Mythic's Flourish may restyle its own entrance, and a Mythic its own takeover look, where the shared one doesn't suit the card. Do it through this set's table and its `fx/cards//` recipes; the shared takeover and the shared Legendary entrance in `fx/takeover.ts` are #2803's to rework. Keep the music (R2722000), when and for whom an entrance plays (R2722002) and the one capped hold (R2722001, as #2785 generalizes it). Update the tests that pin what you change, and amend R2722001 in this part's ruling note. - **New motifs:** add one by the design doc's rule if 3 or more cards fit none. - **Set-piece candidates:** list them in the PR, with a motif for now. ### The deliverable A table in the PR with one row per Classic+ card. Each row gives the card's id and name, then for each hook its motif, palette and scale, or its key or `none` reason. It also gives the census suggestion and why. ## Acceptance - [ ] At least 55% of Classic+'s 78 cards (43 or more) have an entry other than `none`, and every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap has a `cast` entry.
